_header: Parity fixture for the workspace embedding index and the hybrid search
over it - walk, embed, cache, rank.
GENERATED from crates/daemon/src/memory/workspace_index.rs and
memory/retrieval.rs, plus the llm/embed.rs they sit on, by driving the
real Rust in a detached worktree at 9023b46d - the last commit where the
daemon crate builds. Ports to daemon/src/memory/workspace_index.ts,
src/memory/retrieval.ts and src/llm/embed.ts. The generator is not
committed.
This file is FROZEN: nothing regenerates this file. A later diff against it is a defect in the TypeScript, not a fixture that needs updating.
61 scripted end-to-end searches, 8 refresh-phase probes, and roughly 90
pure-function cases.
Every score is f32 the whole way. The Rust accumulated cosine similarity
and blended the lexical and semantic weights in f32, and those numbers
reach the model as decimals, so each step rounds through Math.fround
rather than drifting off in doubles. Comparisons in the replay are exact.
One deliberate divergence: the TypeScript walk sorts each directory's
entries, where the Rust took whatever order the filesystem returned. Which
files a capped workspace indexed therefore varied by filesystem and could
change between runs on the same tree. Below the caps nothing changes; the
capped cases here record counts only, and query for something that matches
nothing.
Mutation-checked at 139 of 140. The first pass was 115 of 142 with the
replay fully green, and the holes were the f32 normalizer, its floor of
one, the negative-similarity clamp, the path tie-break, freshness on size
and on mtime, the byte cap's off-by-one, sub-second mtimes, and the
base_url precedence. Fifteen cases below were designed against those. The
one survivor is the explicit symlink skip, which lstat makes redundant; it
stays because the decision not to follow links out of the workspace
belongs where it is made, and the source says so.
